typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	LoadintotblCatalystUsers_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		lastName as string,
		loginId as string,
		comments as string,
		endDate as timestamp,
		validLoginInd as string,
		fullName as string,
		ownerId as string,
		userId as integer,
		firstName as string,
		password as string,
		effDate as timestamp,
		cacheKey as integer,
		expirationDate as timestamp,
		empKeyId as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CDSUATSourceUsersCatalyst
CDSUATSourceUsersCatalyst sink(input(
		lastName as string,
		loginId as string,
		comments as string,
		endDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		validLoginInd as string,
		fullName as string,
		ownerId as string,
		userId as integer,
		firstName as string,
		password as string,
		effDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		cacheKey as integer,
		expirationDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		empKeyId as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		lastName,
		loginId,
		comments,
		endDate,
		validLoginInd,
		fullName,
		ownerId,
		userId,
		firstName,
		password,
		effDate,
		cacheKey,
		expirationDate,
		empKeyId),
	partitionFileNames:[($LoadintotblCatalystUsers_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> LoadintotblCatalystUsers
